purpose: TI-01 (issue #261). Strings that identify the removed login demo-access affordance and the demo accounts it signed in as. Read by scripts/scan-bundle-demo-identity.mjs (built web/dist) and by web/src/pages/auth/demoIdentity.ti01.test.ts (web/src sources). The values are already public in the repository history; they are listed here so the scans are inspectable.

classes.credential: The shared demo credential. Forbidden everywhere in client code and the bundle.
classes.login-affordance: Labels and identifiers of the removed demo-access controls. Forbidden everywhere in client code and the bundle.
classes.demo-login-identity: Name, email or phone of an account the removed demo controls signed in as. Forbidden unless listed in narrowedResidue.
classes.seed-identity: Email of a backend seed account (backend/db/database.js) that the demo controls targeted. Forbidden in client code and the bundle.
classes.tracked-fabricated-identity: Fabricated personal identity data shown with the demo persona, owned by another TI item. Reported; allowed only as narrowedResidue.

narrowedResidue.reason: The seeded u1 phone is printed on the Privacy Policy telephone card. The public identity remediation packet (docs/communications/CARUP_PUBLIC_IDENTITY_SAFE_REMEDIATION_PACKET.md, row B15) classes this LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, so TI-01 does not edit a statutory contact on its own authority.
KYCVerification pre-fills the u1 first and last name with a fabricated national ID, date of birth and address. Clearing that initial state changes the KYC form's behaviour, which TI-07 owns.
A source comment explains why the fictional leadership section was deleted. Comments are not emitted into the bundle, so the bundle allowance is 0.
